Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No. 615/2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961 registered at Police Station Jafrabad on the ground of settlement.

4. As per the terms of settlement, the petitioners are to pay a sum of Rs.24,00,000/- to the respondent no.2, who is required to give possession of property, A-81, Mata Wali Gali, Near Pooja Model Public School, Rajput Mohalla, Ghonda, Delhi -110053.
